hardRules: Preserve artist_music and all existing music, playback, entitlement, marketplace, feed, profile, EPK, analytics, licensing, royalty and rights-administration paths.
Use additive migrations only; never reset or destructively rewrite the database.
No Phase 21 capability ships under Phase 20 flags.
No trust node, constellation credential, finding aid or emergency copy creates copyright, custody, access, licensing, payment, enforcement or representation authority.
No central trust may override creator, community, Indigenous, local, national or participating-trust authority.
Cross-trust exchanges require exact purpose, current authority, restriction compatibility and immutable manifests.
Public projections are minimized and never authorize high-impact action.
Orbital deployment remains disabled absent a separate legal, scientific, environmental and governmental approval package.
Every task requires evidence, tests, monitoring and rollback before completion.
